title: Chapter XIV
chineseTitle: 第 14 章：忠诚的点灯人

paragraphs.en: The fifth planet was tiny, barely fitting a street lamp and its attendant lamplighter. The little prince pondered the purpose of such a setup on an empty world with no houses.
paragraphs.zh: 第五颗行星微小得可怜，连一根街灯柱和它的守灯人都容不下。王子不禁思索，在一片空旷无人的星球上设置这样的装置究竟有何意义。

paragraphs.en: He mused: "This man may seem absurd, but his job has some meaning. Lighting and extinguishing the lamp is like bringing stars or flowers to life. It’s beautiful and useful."
paragraphs.zh: 他沉思着：“这个人看似荒诞不经，但他的工作却颇有意义。点亮或熄灭灯火就像是赋予星辰和花朵生命，既美好又实用。”

paragraphs.en: Upon arriving, he greeted the lamplighter politely: "Good morning. Why did you just put out your lamp?"
paragraphs.zh: 一到，他礼貌地向灯夫问好：“早上好。你刚才为什么把灯熄灭了？”

paragraphs.en: "Those are the orders," replied the lamplighter.
paragraphs.zh: “这些都是命令，”灯夫回答。

paragraphs.en: "What are these orders?" asked the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “这些命令是什么？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "They instruct me to extinguish my lamp in the evening and relight it in the morning."
paragraphs.zh: 他们吩咐我在晚上熄灭油灯，早上再重新点燃。

paragraphs.en: "But why light it again so soon?" persisted the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “可是为什么这么快就重新点燃呢？”小王子坚持问道。

paragraphs.en: "Orders are orders," said the lamplighter, lighting his lamp once more.
paragraphs.zh: “命令就是命令，”点灯人重新点亮油灯后说道。

paragraphs.en: The lamplighter then wiped his brow with a handkerchief adorned with red squares: "I follow a terrible profession. In the past, I had time for relaxation and sleep. Now, every minute I must light and extinguish my lamp."
paragraphs.zh: 然后，打灯人用一块绣有红色方格的手帕擦了擦额头：“我从事着一份可怕的职业。过去我还有一些休闲和睡眠的时间。现在，每一分钟我都必须点亮或熄灭我的灯笼。”

paragraphs.en: "Have the orders changed recently?" inquired the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “最近有什么新的指示吗？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "No," replied the lamplighter. "That’s the tragedy! The planet rotates faster each year, but the orders remain unchanged!"
paragraphs.zh: “不，”灯夫回答，“这才是悲剧！每一年星球的自转速度都在加快，但订单却一成不变！”

paragraphs.en: "What happens now?" asked the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “接下来会发生什么？”小王子问道。

paragraphs.en: "Now—every minute, I have to relight and extinguish my lamp!"
paragraphs.zh: “现在——每一分钟，我都得重新点亮和熄灭油灯！”

paragraphs.en: The little prince exclaimed: "A day lasts only one minute here!"
paragraphs.zh: 小王子脱口而出：“这里的一天只有一分钟！”

paragraphs.en: The lamplighter corrected him: "It’s not funny. While we talked, a month has passed."
paragraphs.zh: 灯夫纠正他说：“这可不好笑。我们说话的时候，一个月已经过去了。”

paragraphs.en: "Thirty minutes," confirmed the lamplighter, lighting his lamp again.
paragraphs.zh: “三十分钟。”打灯人再次点亮油灯，确认道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince observed the lamplighter and felt a deep affection for him. He remembered the days when he used to seek sunsets by simply moving his chair. Now, he wanted to help his friend.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子观察着点灯人，心中油然生出一份深厚的友情。他想起了过去自己只需移动椅子就能追逐日落的日子，如今他渴望帮助这位朋友。

paragraphs.en: "I can show you how to rest whenever you want," he said.
paragraphs.zh: “我可以用各种方法让你随时得到休息。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: "Always wanting to rest is my nature," replied the lamplighter.
paragraphs.zh: “我生性好休息。”点灯人回答道。

paragraphs.en: A man can be both faithful and lazy. The little prince continued:
paragraphs.zh: 一个人既可以忠诚又可以懒惰。小王子接着说：

paragraphs.en: "On your tiny planet, three steps circle it. To stay in the sun, walk slowly; when you wish to rest, just keep walking—making the day as long as you like."
paragraphs.zh: 在你们这个小小的星球上，只需三步就能绕它一圈。想要沐浴阳光，就慢慢走；想休息时，就继续前行——让一天的时光由你做主。

paragraphs.en: "That doesn't help much," said the lamplighter. "Sleep is what I love most in life."
paragraphs.zh: “这可帮不上什么忙，”灯夫说道，“睡觉是我生活中最爱的事。”

paragraphs.en: "Then you're unlucky," responded the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “那你可真倒霉了。”小王子回答道。

paragraphs.en: "I am unlucky," agreed the lamplighter, and he extinguished his lamp.
paragraphs.zh: “我真是倒霉。”点灯人应道，随即熄灭了手中的油灯。

paragraphs.en: As the little prince continued on his journey, he thought to himself: This man would be scorned by others—by the king, the conceited man, the drunkard, and the businessman. Yet, he seemed less ridiculous than the rest. Perhaps because he was thinking of something beyond himself.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子继续前行，心里暗想：这个人会被别人嘲笑——会被国王、爱慕虚荣的人、酒鬼和商人所轻视。然而，他似乎比其他人显得不那么荒谬。或许是因为他在思考一些超越自己的事情。

paragraphs.en: He sighed and reflected again: This man is the only one I could have made a friend with, but his planet is too small for two people...
paragraphs.zh: 他叹了口气，再次沉思：他是我唯一可能成为朋友的人，但他的星球太小，容不下两个人……

paragraphs.en: What the little prince did not dare admit was that he felt most sorrowful about leaving this planet, which blessed him with 1440 sunsets every day.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子不敢承认的是，他最舍不得的还是这个每天给他带来1440次日落的星球。
